topic_ko: 부모는 자녀가 좋은 가치를 익히도록 코치가 되어야 한다
_note: 주장(argumentative) 유형. FULL set. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase.

passage: Think back to how you first learned to drive a car or cook a meal.
Someone coached you and reminded you what to do until you could finally do it on your own.
Children come to learn their values in much the same way.
As they practice different kinds of behavior, a parent acts as a coach, directing their attention to what truly matters.
Your praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders support them along the way.
If you do not coach your child, she will simply find her coaches elsewhere among the media and her peers.
So step forward and help your child learn, step by step, how to become a good person.
choices: why children naturally pick up good values without any adult help
why learning to drive is harder than learning to cook a meal
how parents should coach their children to learn good values themselves
how the media can teach children useful skills more effectively
why praise and encouragement can spoil a growing child
theme.explanation_ko: 운전·요리를 코치를 받으며 익히듯, 부모가 코치가 되어 자녀가 좋은 가치를 스스로 익히도록 도와야 한다는 글이다. '부모가 자녀의 가치 학습을 코치해야 한다'는 ③이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①어른 도움 없이 저절로, ②운전·요리 난이도 비교, ④미디어의 효과적 교육, ⑤칭찬이 아이를 망친다는 본문과 반대이거나 무관하다.

passage: Remember that you learned to drive or cook only because someone coached you through it.
You practiced under guidance until the skill became automatic and you could coach yourself.
Children learn their values in exactly the same gradual way.
As they try out different behaviors, parents must act as coaches who highlight what is important.
Praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders are the tools of this everyday coaching.
Leave a child without your coaching, and the media and her friends will gladly take that role instead.
Therefore, parents should step up and actively guide their children toward becoming good people.
choices: 자녀의 가치 교육은 학교와 또래에게 전적으로 맡겨야 한다.
부모는 칭찬보다 엄격한 처벌로 자녀를 가르쳐야 한다.
운전이나 요리 같은 기술부터 자녀에게 먼저 가르쳐야 한다.
자녀는 스스로 가치를 깨달을 때까지 부모가 기다려 주어야 한다.
부모는 코치가 되어 자녀가 좋은 가치를 익히도록 적극 이끌어야 한다.
claim.explanation_ko: 기술을 코치받아 익히듯, 부모가 코치가 되어 자녀가 좋은 가치를 익히도록 적극적으로 이끌어야 한다는 주장이다. ⑤가 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①또래·학교에 일임, ②처벌 강조, ③기술 우선 교육, ④그저 기다리기는 본문 주장과 반대이거나 무관하다.

passage: You once learned to drive or cook with someone coaching you step by step.
With practice, the skill became second nature and you no longer needed a coach.
Children acquire values through the very same kind of guided practice.
Parents serve as coaches, focusing a child's attention on what matters and refining key skills.
Praise and gentle reminders keep the child moving in the right direction.
Without a parent's coaching, a child will be shaped by the values of the media and her peers.
So parents should not hesitate, but help their child become a good person, little by little.
choices: 좋은 가치는 부모가 가르치지 않아도 또래에게서 자연히 배운다.
부모는 자녀가 좋은 가치를 익히도록 코치 역할을 해야 한다.
운전과 요리는 어릴 때부터 가르쳐야 평생 잊지 않는다.
지나친 칭찬은 자녀의 자율성을 해치므로 삼가야 한다.
미디어는 자녀에게 가장 효과적인 가치 교육의 도구이다.
gist.explanation_ko: 기술을 코치받아 익히듯, 부모가 코치가 되어 자녀가 좋은 가치를 익히도록 도와야 한다는 것이 요지이다. ②가 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①또래에게서 자연 습득, ③기술 조기 교육, ④칭찬 자제, ⑤미디어 활용은 요지와 다르거나 본문과 반대이다.

passage: Recall how you learned to drive a car or prepare a meal for the first time.
A coach guided you, reminding you what to do until the skill became automatic.
Children pick up their values through this same patient, guided practice.
Parents, as coaches, direct a child's attention to what is important and fine-tune key skills.
Praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders are the heart of the job.
Skip the coaching and the media and peers will eagerly coach the child instead.
So step up to the plate and help your child learn to be good, one step at a time.
choices: Let Children Discover Their Own Values Alone
Why Driving and Cooking Should Be Taught Early
The Media: A Child's Most Trusted Teacher
Be Your Child's Coach for Good Values
Too Much Praise Ruins a Growing Child
title.explanation_ko: 부모가 코치가 되어 자녀의 가치 학습을 이끌어야 한다는 핵심을 담은 ④가 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①혼자 깨닫게 두기, ②기술 조기 교육, ③미디어 신뢰, ⑤칭찬의 폐해는 본문 핵심과 반대이거나 빗나간다.

passage: Children learn values the way you learned to drive or cook, through guided practice.
Parents act as coaches, focusing a child's attention on what is important.
Praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders keep that learning on track.
But suppose you decide not to take on this coaching role at all.
If you don't coach your child, she will find her coaches elsewhere.
Then the media, her peers, and anyone who captures her interest will shape her values.
So step up and help your child learn, step by step, to become a good person.
implication.underlined: she will find her coaches elsewhere
choices: she will hire a professional tutor to teach her good manners
her values will be shaped by the media and peers instead of by you
she will travel far away to look for a better school
she will quickly forget everything her parents once taught her
she will refuse to learn any new skills from adults at all
implication.explanation_ko: '다른 데서 코치를 찾는다'는 것은 부모가 가르치지 않으면 미디어와 또래가 대신 그 아이의 가치를 형성하게 된다는 뜻이다. ②가 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①전문 과외, ③먼 학교, ④망각, ⑤배움 거부는 비유의 의미와 다르다.

passage: Remember how you learned to drive or cook?
You practiced while someone coached you until you were able coaching yourself.
Children learn values much the same way as adults learn new skills.
They practice different kinds of behavior, while you, as coach, help focus their attention on what is important.
You support them with your praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders.
If you don't coach your child, she will find her coaches elsewhere and be guided by the values of the media.
So step up to the plate and help your child learn how to be a good person.
grammar.explanation_ko: ① 'be able to + 동사원형(~할 수 있다)' 구조이므로 'able to coach'가 와야 한다. 'able coaching'은 비문이다. ①이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ②선행사 포함 관계대명사 what is important, ③주어 you에 호응하는 support, ④조동사 will 뒤 find와 병렬되는 원형 be guided, ⑤help + 목적어 + 원형부정사 learn은 모두 옳다.

passage: Remember how you learned to drive or cook with someone's help?
You practiced while someone coached you until you could coach yourself automatically.
Children learn values in much the same way through guided practice.
As coach, you help focus their attention on what is trivial and on fine-tuning key skills.
You support them with your praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders.
If you don't coach your child, she will find her coaches elsewhere among the media and her peers.
So step up and help your child learn how to be a good person, step by step.
vocab.explanation_ko: ② 코치인 부모는 '중요한(important)' 것에 아이의 주의를 집중시킨다는 흐름이다. '사소한(trivial)'은 정반대 의미라 부적절하므로 important로 고쳐야 한다. ②가 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①코치하다(coached), ③격려(encouragement), ④다른 곳에서(elsewhere), ⑤돕다(help)는 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: Remember how you learned to drive or cook with a coach reminding you what to do?
You practiced under guidance until you could finally do it automatically.
Children learn values in much the same way through guided practice.
As coach, parents focus a child's attention on what is important and refine key skills.
If you don't coach your child, she will __________.
The media, her peers, and anyone who captures her interest will shape her values instead.
So step up and help your child learn, step by step, to become a good person.
choices: master every skill without any help
become a coach for other children
blank.explanation_ko: 다음 문장에서 '미디어·또래가 대신 가치를 형성한다'고 했으므로, 부모가 코치하지 않으면 아이는 '다른 데서 코치를 찾는다(find her coaches elsewhere)'가 들어가야 한다. ④가 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ①혼자 통달, ②흥미 상실, ③부모를 가르침, ⑤다른 아이의 코치가 됨은 뒤 문장과 연결되지 않는다.

irrelevant.intro: Children learn good values the way you once learned to drive or cook, through guided practice with a coach.
sentences: As children practice different kinds of behavior, parents act as coaches who focus their attention on what is important.
Praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders are the everyday tools a parent uses to support this learning.
Modern cars now include many automatic safety features that reduce the number of road accidents.
If parents do not take on this coaching role, the media and peers will shape a child's values instead.
So parents should step up and help their child learn, step by step, how to become a good person.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '부모가 코치가 되어 자녀의 가치를 가르쳐야 한다'는 흐름인데, ③ '현대 자동차의 자동 안전 기능이 사고를 줄인다'는 무관한 내용이다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②④⑤는 모두 부모의 코치 역할과 가치 교육이라는 주제로 이어진다.

order.given: Remember how you learned to drive or cook? You practiced while someone coached you until you could finally do it automatically.

blocks.A: In the same way, children learn values, practicing different behaviors while you, as coach, focus their attention on what is important.
blocks.B: You do this by supporting them with your praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders along the way.
blocks.C: If you don't take on this role, she will find her coaches elsewhere, so step up and help your child learn to be a good person.

order.explanation_ko: 코칭으로 기술을 익힌 경험(주어진 글)을 (A)가 'In the same way'로 가치 학습에 연결, (B)가 'do this'로 코칭 방법(칭찬·격려)을 설명, (C)가 코치하지 않을 때의 결과와 결론으로 마무리한다. (A)-(B)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 'do this'는 (A)의 코치 역할을 받으므로 (A) 뒤라야 하고, (C)의 결론은 마지막이다.

insert.insert_sentence: If you don't coach your child, she will find her coaches elsewhere among the media and her peers.

passage_marked.text: Remember how you learned to drive or cook while someone coached you?
Children learn values in much the same way through guided practice.
As coach, you focus their attention on what is important and support them with praise and encouragement.
So step up to the plate and help your child learn how to be a good person.
Take this role seriously, because the values your child builds now will last a lifetime.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 '부모가 코치하지 않으면 미디어·또래가 코치가 된다'는 경고이다. 부모의 코치 역할 설명(③ 문장) 뒤이자 '그러니 나서라(So step up)'는 결론(④ 문장) 앞에 와야 인과가 자연스럽다. ③이 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 코치하지 않을 때의 결과(주어진 문장)가 있어야 ④의 'So step up'이라는 결론이 자연스럽게 이어진다.

passage: You learned to drive or cook because a coach guided you until the skill became automatic.
Children acquire their values through this very same kind of guided practice.
Parents serve as coaches, focusing a child's attention on what is important.
They support the child with praise, encouragement, and gentle reminders.
If parents do not coach, the media and peers will shape the child's values instead.
So parents should step up and help their child become a good person, step by step.
summary.summary_template: Just as a coach helped you master a skill, parents should actively __(A)__ their children, or else the media and peers will __(B)__ their values.
summary.explanation_ko: 부모가 자녀를 적극적으로 (A)coach(코치)해야 하며, 그러지 않으면 미디어·또래가 자녀의 가치를 (B)shape(형성)하게 된다. ③.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 coach, (B)는 shape여야 한다. ignore/punish/replace나 protect/weaken은 글의 논지와 맞지 않는다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 아이들은 거의 같은 방식으로 가치를 배운다.
writing.answer: Children learn values much the same way.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 Children + 동사 learn + 목적어 values + 방법 부사구 much the same way.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.answer: You support them with your praise and encouragement.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 You + 동사 support + 목적어 them + 수단 with your praise and encouragement.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 만약 당신이 자녀를 코치하지 않으면, 그 아이는 다른 데서 자신의 코치를 찾을 것이다.
writing.answer: If you don't coach your child, she will find her coaches elsewhere.
writing.explanation_ko: If + 현재시제 조건절(don't coach) + 주절 will find. 조건의 부사절에서는 미래도 현재형.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: As coach, you help focus their attention on what is ___________ and on fine-tuning key skills.
writing.explanation_ko: 코치인 부모는 '중요한(important)' 것에 아이의 주의를 집중시킨다는 흐름이다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Step up to the plate and help your child learn how to be a good person, step by step.
writing.answer: 나서서 당신의 자녀가 좋은 사람이 되는 법을 한 걸음씩 배우도록 도우라.
writing.explanation_ko: step up to the plate(나서다), help + 목적어 + 동사원형 learn, step by step(한 걸음씩).
